{
  "name": "session-radar",
  "version": "0.3.0",
  "description": "A live sidebar for long sessions: usage limits, context, agents, background shells and progress at a glance",
  "author": {
    "name": "Ibrahim Kobeissy",
    "url": "https://github.com/ibrahimkobeissy"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/ibrahimkobeissy/claude-mods/tree/main/mods/session-radar",
  "repository": "https://github.com/ibrahimkobeissy/claude-mods",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "sidebar",
    "pane",
    "agents",
    "background",
    "shells",
    "usage",
    "limits",
    "context",
    "monitor"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "autoOpen": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Open on start",
      "description": "Open the radar pane when a session starts (only where it fits as a sidebar)",
      "default": true
    }
  }
}
